annotation.title_clean: 湖南省人民政府办公厅印发《关于支持全省低空经济高质量发展的若干政策措施》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the Hunan Provincial People's Government on Issuing Several Policy Measures to Support High-Quality Development of the Low-Altitude Economy Across the Province
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 湖南省人民政府办公厅
annotation.venue: 湖南省人民政府门户网站
annotation.summary_en: Hunan provincial government general office policy (Xiangzhengbanfa [2024] No. 20) with twelve measures supporting the low-altitude economy: subsidies for general aviation, eVTOL and drone logistics routes, infrastructure, surveillance, finance, talent and industrial clustering. Effective 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2027.
key_provisions_or_claims: Operating subsidies for general aviation, eVTOL/flying cars and drone logistics and delivery routes
Subsidies and rewards for aircraft manufacturing, R&D platforms and enterprise recruitment
Support for general airports, vertiport sites, charging and low-altitude surveillance (Beidou) infrastructure
Government purchase of low-altitude public services, insurance products and financing support
Valid 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2027; detailed rules to be issued separately
